visible_text: Windows は次の周で追います。
決まったことを待っています…
やることを待っています…
オンボーディングを試作する

answers.q1: Grounded, and I can tell. Each memo item shows a speaker name (Ken/Sarah), a timestamp, and an explicit '出所' (source) link, and the same wording also appears verbatim in the transcript panel on the right (e.g. '10:42 Ken macOSを先に出します' matches the memo item). That pairing reads as extraction-from-speech, not an AI guess.
answers.q2: I would click '出所' (source) directly under the memo item — it is labeled exactly for this purpose, right next to the item text, no hunting required.
answers.q3: Yes. Every memo item carries a name and a timestamp both in the bold header line and again in the small metadata line below (e.g. 'Ken · 10:42 · 出所 > · 直す').
answers.q4: I would click '直す' (fix), which sits immediately next to '出所' under each item — it's visibly present as a correction affordance. I did not need to hunt for it; it's the second of two identical small links under every memo entry.
answers.q5: Fairly comfortable for the two concrete memo items — they carry attribution and a visible correction path, which reads as trustworthy. Less comfortable for the '決まったこと' (decisions) and 'やること' (to-dos) sections, which are still empty ('...を待っています') since the recording is only 2 seconds old — sharing now would just be sharing a mostly blank template.

weaknesses.what: It's unclear what clicking '出所' actually does — jump to the transcript line, highlight it, or open something else. Since the same text is already visible in the transcript pane, the payoff of the click is not signaled.
weaknesses.fix: On hover/click, scroll the transcript panel to and highlight the exact source line so the link's effect is obvious before clicking.

weaknesses.what: '直す' is a small low-contrast text link identical in weight to '出所', tucked into a metadata row below each item — easy to overlook among several similarly-styled small blue links.
weaknesses.fix: Give '直す' a slightly stronger visual weight (icon or button chip) so it reads as an action distinct from the informational '出所' link.

weaknesses.what: '決まったこと' and 'やること' each show a full-width empty placeholder ('...を待っています') that occupies real vertical space while conveying nothing, making the left panel feel emptier/sparser than the right transcript panel this early in the meeting.
weaknesses.fix: Collapse empty sections into a single compact line or hide them until the first item lands, rather than reserving full block space for a waiting state.
